features.feature_value: Uses repeated party labels as the main targets (Republicans/Democrats)
features.rationale: The post is structured around an across-the-board critique of a political party group.

features.feature_value: Strong profanity directed at a political group
features.rationale: Uses explicit profanity as part of the dismissal/condemnation of the target group.

features.feature_value: Short profanity-based attack on a politician + followers
features.rationale: The core content is an explicit profanity attack.

features.feature_value: Claim about who pays taxes plus corruption/illegal-immigrant blame
features.rationale: Centers on fiscal responsibility framed with corruption and immigration accusations.

features.feature_value: Gun-control policy with named mechanism (red flag laws)
features.rationale: Explicitly references firearm regulation via red flag laws.
Uses a dehumanizing label to characterize the people being criticized.

features.feature_value: Accuses a specific ideological actor of profiteering/fraud and ends with obscene dismissal
features.evidence_span: "billionaire to dirt poor" ... "dying overdosed on fentanyl" ... "Fuck nazis."
features.rationale: Frames the target as exploiting others and highlights wrongdoing through extreme moral/personal claims.

features.feature_value: Conditional concession plus series of rhetorical/leading questions about voter perspectives
features.evidence_span: "Even if I grant that, is that not better" ... "Do you think"
features.rationale: Uses an 'even if' concession and questions to steer interpretation of political/legal changes.
